acceptance.given: A target evaluation request identifies a target that escapes its allowed boundary.

oracle.expected: The boundary evaluation records rejection and produces no successful evaluation result.
forbidden: Inspecting the escaping target as valid.
Continuing evaluation after the escape is detected.
oracle.observable: The target-boundary validation outcome emitted by the Toolchain evaluation path.

acceptance.when: The Toolchain evaluation path evaluates the supplied target boundary.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the target-boundary negative validator so an escaping target must fail closed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain evaluation path reject targets that escape the allowed boundary before a successful evaluation can be produced.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting restores the prior Toolchain boundary evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A request containing an escaping target transitions to rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A boundary-escaping target has a rejection outcome and no successful evaluation result.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded without an established independent command-verification outcome.

oracle.expected: Each successful Replay Result contains its own command-verification outcome derived from that result's command.
forbidden: Inferring a successful Replay Result's command verification from another verification.
oracle.observable: The per-Replay-Result command-verification record emitted by the replay path.

acceptance.then: The command has been independently verified.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the replay command-verification behavior test with a successful result whose command verification is absent or borrowed from another result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require every successful Replay Result to carry an independently derived command-verification outcome rather than inheriting verification from another result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting restores prior replay command-verification handling.

slice_hint.state_transition: A successful Replay Result without independent command verification transitions to independently command-verified or fails verification.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every successful Replay Result exposes an independent command-verification outcome for its own command.

acceptance.given: The retained S41 snapshot-exclusions fixture exists with its declared role.

oracle.expected: The fixture is evaluated only as the declared snapshot-exclusions fixture; existence alone supplies no behavior proof.
forbidden: Treating fixture existence as proof of behavior.
Assigning the fixture a role beyond its declaration.
oracle.observable: The S41 fixture-role evaluation performed during semantic contract assessment.

acceptance.when: The fixture is retained or evaluated during S41 contract assessment.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S41 semantic contract test with fixture existence used as behavior proof or with an undeclared fixture role.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve the snapshot-exclusions fixture strictly as declared fixture context and reject any assessment that treats its existence as behavior evidence or expands its role.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting restores prior Toolchain fixture-role assessment behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A retained snapshot-exclusions fixture remains role-limited during S41 assessment.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The semantic assessment records the fixture only in its declared role and does not accept its existence as behavior proof.

acceptance.given: Execution has not yet established that both subjects ran for every Matrix Case.

oracle.expected: Aggregate execution evidence contains both subjects for each of the six distinct Matrix Cases.
forbidden: A Matrix Case executing only one subject.
Either subject being absent from any Matrix Case execution.
oracle.observable: The six-case Matrix aggregate emitted by the Toolchain replay and semantic-gate execution path.

acceptance.then: Both subjects have executed for all six Matrix Cases.
acceptance.when: The Matrix Case aggregate is executed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the Matrix aggregate behavior test with either subject omitted from any one of the six Matrix Cases.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Matrix aggregate require execution evidence for both subjects in each of its six distinct cases and fail when any subject execution is missing.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting restores prior Matrix aggregate subject-coverage handling.

slice_hint.state_transition: A Matrix aggregate with six cases transitions to successful coverage only after both subjects execute in every case.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The six-case aggregate shows both subjects executed in every Matrix Case; any missing subject execution fails the aggregate.
